decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system extends the firm's office furniture competence, and its own R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the models.
The chair family sits close to the firm's core upholstery and seating know-how, so it is easy to assimilate and improve.
The floor cushions build on the firm's textile and material expertise, though as a small accessory line they are somewhat more exposed to pruning.
The sofa is close to the firm's upholstery core, but its weak presence on the website (only mentioned) suggests modest prominence.
The high standing table is a natural extension of the firm's conference and office tables and fits its existing knowledge.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's core, which makes learning from early results harder, but its flagship status and the firm's own R&D and design partners support keeping it for now.
